Type a line and hear it as a video-game voice: six chip machines, stage directions, and WAV downloads. Everything is synthesized on your computer, so there are no samples and nothing to license.

| Your computer | Download |
| --- | --- |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 and later) | `8-bit-Voice-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac with an Intel chip | `8-bit-Voice-mac-x64.dmg` |
| Windows 10 or 11 | `8-bit-Voice-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows on Arm | `8-bit-Voice-windows-arm64-setup.exe` |
| Linux, any distro | `8-bit-Voice-linux-x86_64.AppImage` (Arm: `-arm64.AppImage`) |
| Debian or Ubuntu | `8-bit-Voice-linux-amd64.deb` (Arm: `-arm64.deb`) |
| A phone, or anything else | [bomkino.github.io/8bit-Voice](https://bomkino.github.io/8bit-Voice/), which you can add to your Home Screen |

These apps aren't signed by Apple or Microsoft, so each system asks once before it opens one. [Here's what to click.](https://github.com/bomkino/8bit-Voice#opening-it-the-first-time)

`SHA256SUMS.txt` has a checksum for every file.
